entities.name: NAS Ciphering Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for applying ciphering to NAS signaling messages between UE and AMF after secure exchange is established.

entities.name: Null Ciphering Algorithm 5G-EA0
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm indicating no ciphering is applied, used when network operates without ciphering.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
entities.description: NAS message sent unciphered by AMF even after ciphering has started.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Connection over which NAS messages are exchanged between UE and AMF.

entities.name: Secure exchange of NAS messages established
entities.description: Condition indicating that secure exchange is established for an N1 NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Inter-system change to S1 mode
entities.description: Condition that stops ciphering when UE changes to S1 mode.

entities.name: Discard unciphered NAS messages
entities.description: Behavior where receiver discards unciphered messages once ciphering has started.

relations.description: Ciphering starts when secure exchange of NAS messages is established.
Null ciphering algorithm is used when network operates without ciphering.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is sent unciphered even after ciphering starts.
Ciphering applies until N1 NAS signalling connection is released.
Ciphering stops when UE performs inter-system change to S1 mode.
Once ciphering starts, unciphered messages are discarded.
